items.title: A resolution of a normal two dimensional local ring yields a resolution by normalized blowups

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the spectrum of a normal two dimensional Noetherian local ring has a resolution of singularities then it has a resolution by normalized blowups (statement lines 3949-3955). The proof (proof lines 3957-4048) reduces to the complete case via the behaviour of normality and regularity under completion, dominates the given resolution by normalized blowups and then by point blowups, propagates rationality of the singularities from the regular points below, passes to Gorenstein local rings by finitely many blowups, and finishes by resolving the resulting rational double points. H3: a multi-stage reduction combining several chapter results with genuine transfers of properties, written out in full.
